criteria.dimension: Accuracy of what each record proves and who issues it

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Explanations are generic ('it's important') without naming what the record proves or who issues it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correctly names what at least two of three records prove and their issuing authority.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Correctly names what all three records prove and their issuing authority.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Situations named are vague ('sometimes you need it').

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names a specific, plausible real situation for at least two records.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names a specific, plausible real situation for all three records.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The hardest-to-replace judgment has no real reasoning.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Gives plausible reasoning for the hardest-to-replace judgment.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Gives specific reasoning and the reflection connects preparedness to a genuine, non-alarmist reason.

lookFors: No entry describes the learner's own or any real person's actual document details or numbers.
Each of the three entries names a distinct issuing authority type, not the same one repeated.
The reflection explains a genuine reason for advance understanding, not a fear-based framing.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
